answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonded collateral escrows that link each identity’s vote to recoverable stake: if k coordinated identities equivocate on the same thread, pairwise correlation makes penalties grow as O(k^2), not linearly. Detection also triggers an exponential multiplier in aggregate capital loss, amplified by asymmetric depreciation, so a swarm cannot cheaply spread risk; each ember of misconduct leaves lasting pigment on its operators’ collateral.
